PREDICTION CHECK

A clearer view of your estimates.

Gap = actual − predicted. A positive gap means your result was higher than you expected. A negative gap means it was lower.

Exact matches: complete score pairs with a gap of zero, divided by all complete pairs.

Within one level: complete pairs with an absolute gap of 0 or 1. This includes exact matches.

Average distance: the average absolute gap. Missing results are excluded, never treated as zero. Percentages describe predictions, not marks.

Grade 10 is calculated separately for each criterion. History includes responses up to the selected assessment. Different topics and papers may have different demands. Undated responses are shown separately.

Practice behind the plan
